correctness.rationale: For a centrally symmetric section, any inscribed disk can be centered by averaging; the six half-plane distances give R=(1-min|u_i|²)^(-1/2). A section is six-sided iff the three absolute normal coordinates satisfy strict triangle inequalities. A full 48-sector spherical parametrization has exactly unit area element dz dt; splitting the allowed angle at pi/4-phi(z) yields the stated two joint densities and their sharp junction z=1/sqrt(6). The continuous ratio is strictly increasing. The actual packaged independent polygon-hull verifier passes 2500 sections, normalization and unconditional face-count marginal.

value.rationale: This is a complete exact joint law for a canonical random polytope section and two distinct natural observables (inradius, side count). It yields a sharp nontrivial topological phase threshold sqrt(6/5), strictly monotone conditional six-sided probability and positive association of inradius with type, none of which is contained in the known face-count marginal.
